assertions.assertion: Calls AddOAuth2Introspection with Authority set to 'https://auth.mycompany.com'
Sets ClientId to 'invoicing' and ClientSecret to 'invoicing_secret'
assertions.rationale: options.ClientId = "invoicing" and options.ClientSecret = "invoicing_secret" are both configured.

assertions.assertion: Mentions or adds the Duende.AspNetCore.Authentication.OAuth2Introspection or Duende.IdentityServer.AccessTokenValidation package
Warns that the ApiResource in IdentityServer must have ApiSecrets configured for introspection to work
assertions.rationale: States the corresponding API resource must have a matching secret configured on its side or introspection calls will be rejected, though it does not name the ApiSecrets property or show code.
